overview_description.description: Asendia AI develops a generative AI platform that automates HR tasks for recruitment. The platform helps businesses and recruitment firms enhance their processes. It utilizes an agentic-based framework to streamline various HR functions, improving efficiency and reducing time spent on recruitment activities. The focus is on providing tools that assist job seekers in preparing for interviews and helping businesses identify suitable candidates efficiently.

product.name: Sarah: AI Recruiter
product.description: An AI-powered recruitment assistant that screens candidates through automated interviews, providing detailed assessments and scheduling to streamline hiring.

product.name: Talent Hub
product.description: A platform connecting employers to a global pool of pre-assessed candidates who have passed AI-driven interviews for faster talent sourcing.

product.name: AI Career Coach
product.description: An AI-based career guidance platform that offers personalized job matching, resume adaptation, interview preparation, and application tracking for job seekers.

product.name: AI Interview Practice Templates
product.description: A collection of expert-vetted interview templates from major companies to help candidates prepare for specific interview formats and questions.

product.name: AI Interviewer Buddy
product.description: A customizable AI assistant that conducts mock interviews and offers feedback to help users improve their interview skills.
